newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish Yasar group to concentrate on paint, food.
newsitem.headline: Turkish Yasar group to concentrate on paint, food.

text.p: Turkey's Aegean-based food, industrial and banking group Yasar Holding plans to concentrate on its food and paint activities and sell its paper plant, a senior company official said.
"We will remain in the finance sector, but we will grow and keep our leading positions in the food and paint sectors in Turkey," Selim Yasar, board member of Yasar Holding, told Reuters.
Yasar group, with more than 40 companies, including 10 public ones, plans to merge all its companies operating in the food industry.

Pinar Et with slaughtering, cutting and packaging units, produces red and white meat and ready-to-eat meals. The group also runs a flour company Pinar Un, a bottled water company Pinar Su and a dairy firm Pinar Sut.
"We will merge all our food companies under Pinar Gida Sanayi A.S. and make Pinar a global brand, as the leading food company of Turkey," Yasar said.
The group has invested $120 million in food projects such as establishing new milk and water bottling plants, modernisation and setting up a new turkey slaughtering facility.
Yasar Holding is the major shareholder of Turk Tuborg brewery, the second biggest firm in the Turkish beer sector with a 23 percent market share.
Yasar group also owns the leading company in Turkey's paint sector, Yasar Boya ve Kimya Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S., which had a 33.5 percent market share in Turkey last year.
"Our target is to expand our slice to 35 percent in the growing Turkish paint sector, and keep our leading position" he said.
Turkey's paint sector, with an annual growth rate of 14 percent, attracts international companies.
Yasar said American ICI (Imperial Chemical) spent $40,000 on market research, Herbertz set up a fully-owned subsidiary and Akzo Nobel of the Netherlands, PPG and Du Pont were also eyeing the market.
Yasar group established a 50/50 joint venture with BASF to market car paints, Yasar said, adding that strong foreign interest would naturally bring company purchases or joint-ventures in the future.
He said Yasar group would sell a 51 percent stake in their paper company Viking Kagit ve Seluloz A.S. and focus on producing paint chemicals at their fertilizer company Ege Gubre Sanayii A.S..
Yasar group reported a 60.12-trillion-lira gross turnover in 1995, according to its consolidated income statement, against 31.22 trillion lira in 1994.
Net consolidated profits of the group rose to 1.31 trillion lira in 1995, from 812 billion lira in 1994.
